observations.summary: Reuters reports that ACLED, International Crisis Group and sources linked to opposing Tigrayan factions describe Ethiopian and Eritrean forces massed within striking distance near their border. ACLED alleges exchanges on November 12-13, but Reuters could not verify direct interstate clashes, and a pro-Ethiopian militia source disputes them. ACLED previously reported Eritrean reinforcement and defensive positions around Badme by November 15. New element is Reuters' November 18 multi-source synthesis, not a newly timed troop movement. Do not count Reuters republications or the same ACLED reporting as independent corroboration.
observations.title: Reuters reports Ethiopian and Eritrean force concentrations near Badme; direct clashes disputed
